title: Completed evaluation of normalized scalar comparisons
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, and a separated finite-type $D.k$-scheme $X$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $E,L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $i:E\to L$ a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding. Let $w_E,w_L$ be coherent integral dualizing data [def-sf-coherent-integral-dualizing-datum], and $A,B$ supplied normalized rational Verdier data [def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Write $Q_E,Q_L$ for the raw rational localizations, $T$ for integral scalar extension, and $\bar T$ for its rational scalar extension [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Write $D_E=A.\mathrm{dual}$ and $D_L=B.\mathrm{dual}$, and $\beta_K$ for the actual evaluation-transpose integral comparison in the presentations $A.\mathrm{ordinary},B.\mathrm{ordinary}$ [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core]. Let $e$ be an Extension from $A$ to $B$ [def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Assume $e.\omega=Q_L(u)$ and $e.\mathrm{comparison}_{Q_EK_0}=Q_L(\beta_{K_0})$ on every integral representative, with the prescribed endpoint identifications. Then for every rational object $K$, $$\otimes_L(1_{\bar TK},e.\mathrm{comparison}_K);\mathrm{ev}_{B,\bar TK}=\bar c^{-1}_{K,D_EK};\bar T(\mathrm{ev}_{A,K});e.\omega,$$ where $\bar c$ is the specified rationalTensorScalarComparison [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. This asserts only evaluation compatibility of an already supplied normalized comparison, with no existence, naturality or biduality conclusion.

proof.text: Uncurry homMap by the inverse tensor-Hom adjunction. By its definition the result is inverse ordinary scalar tensorator followed by scalar extension of the source counit. Uncurry v by naturality in the second variable and the completion isomorphisms, and then uncurry beta by postcomposing with u. This yields ordinary scalar-extended evaluation followed by u, with all three completion comparisons retained.

proof.text: Conjugate the resulting tensorator by A.completion and B.completion. On good K-flat representatives its maps on homogeneous tensors are multiplication of coefficient factors followed by the given quotient projections; the shifted mapping-fiber coordinate is zero on both paths. The normalizations of the completion and scalar tensor comparisons therefore agree there. Full faithfulness of restriction to the good K-flat product localization identifies the natural comparisons on constructible objects. This proves the completed evaluation square.

proof.text: Apply Q_L, preserving composites. Substitute A.evaluation_integral, B.evaluation_integral and the two normalization hypotheses on e. The rational tensorator is the localization of the same specified integral tensorator. Its inverse gives exactly the displayed orientation. Each rational object is a wrapped integral object, so there is no further object descent or lattice existence assertion.

theorem normalizedExtension_evaluation
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] L)
    (wE : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (wL : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl L)
    (A : Datum D l hl X E wE) (B : Datum D l hl X L wL)
    (e : Extension D l hl X E L i wE wL A B)
    (hu : (HEq e.omega.hom ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l L X).map
    (ObjectProperty.homMk (X := (integralScalar l X E L i).obj wE.omega) (Y := wL.omega)
      (IntegralFiniteExtension.u l E L i X D hl wE wL)))))
    (hb : (∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X,
    HEq (e.comparison.hom.app (op ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K)))
      ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l L X).map
        (ObjectProperty.homMk
          (X := (integralScalar l X E L i).obj
            ((IntegralVerdier.restrictedDual l E X wE.omega.obj A.preserves).obj (op K)))
          (Y := (IntegralVerdier.restrictedDual l L X wL.omega.obj B.preserves).obj
            (op ((integralScalar l X E L i).obj K)))
          (IntegralFiniteExtension.beta l E L i X D hl wE wL A.ordinary B.ordinary
            K.obj K.property.1))))) :
    (∀ K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
    (tensor D l hl X L).map
        (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 ((scalar l X E L i).obj K)) (e.comparison.hom.app (op K))) ≫
      B.evaluation ((scalar l X E L i).obj K) =
    (@rationalTensorScalarComparison l _ E _ _ _ L _ _ _ i X (units D l hl X)).inv.app
        (K, A.dual.obj (op K)) ≫
      (scalar l X E L i).map (A.evaluation K) ≫ e.omega.hom)
